استؤمنت (form X)

# اُسْتُؤْمِنْتَ (ustuʔminta) /us.tuʔ.min.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# اُسْتُؤْمِنْتِ (ustuʔminti) /us.tuʔ.min.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَأْمَنَ (istaʔmana)
# اُسْتُؤْمِنَتْ (ustuʔminat) /u
